name: Mizuna harvest · exploratory ridge
validation: Nested 4-fold GroupKFold, paired pillow numbers kept together; inner 3-fold alpha search. One experiment only; folds do not establish cross-study generalization.

interval.kind: 90th percentile absolute outer-CV residual, uncalibrated descriptive range

limitations: Only 14 measured harvest outcomes from VEG04A; not validated for another experiment or spacecraft.
Crop is mizuna, not lettuce, tomato or radish. No cross-crop prediction.
Full-period irrigation is a retrospective input; this is not an early harvest forecast or causal irrigation recommendation.
Irrigation supplied is not physiological water demand or transpiration.
Small-data regression may underperform its baseline; see measured metrics.
No gravity-dose, radiation, temperature or humidity treatment effects can be learned from these tables.
sourceType: NASA OSDR (OSD-655) VEG-01/02 pick-and-eat harvest records
license: Public OSDR access; retain study attribution and comply with OSDR terms; do not assume every contributed file is public domain.
sourceLicense: Public OSDR access; retain study attribution and comply with OSDR terms; do not assume every contributed file is public domain.
sourceCitation: NASA Open Science Data Repository, OSD-655: Pick-and-eat space crop production flight testing on the International Space Station.
servedScope: Withdrawn in Phase 31. Held-out R2 was -0.333, i.e. worse than predicting the mean, so no forecast of mizuna harvest is offered by any route, workflow, catalogue entry or assistant passage. The card is retained as a non-serving record of that evaluation.

archivalRecord.reason: A withdrawn model keeps its artifact and its evaluation so the withdrawal is auditable; backend/tests/test_phase32_no_forecast.py proves it is unreachable.

note: No operational forecast. This card describes what the model reproduces inside the measured domain; it is not a prediction of a future or unmeasured crop.
